files.title: File:Hippodrome Theatre (Peoples Bank Theatre), Putnam Street, Marietta, OH - 54320380742.jpg
files.author: w_lemay
files.caption: Built in 1919, this building was heavily renovated in 1949 in the Colonial Revival style under the direction of Charles M Stotz and Edward Stotz.  The building is clad in painted brick with a second-story cast iron porch, a front pediment with a fanlight window, nine-over-six double-hung windows, and a large recessed entrance bay with multiple double doors and a ticket booth.  The building is a contributing structure in the Marietta Historic District, listed on the National Register of Historic
